research_mode: official Home Office and ONS sources only; 2026 recording-rule updates, user-guide revision and open-table structure controls; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: National recording standard
verified_claims: Home Office Crime Recording Rules provide a national standard for recording and counting notifiable offences in England and Wales
limitations: the rules govern recorded crime and do not measure unreported crime

sources.name: 16 July 2026 outcomes update
verified_claims: the page records an outcomes-framework guidance update on 16 July 2026
limitations: update date must be tied to the attached guidance version

sources.name: 22 May 2026 rule deletion
verified_claims: a specified paragraph on N300 sudden or unexplained death reporting was deleted on 22 May 2026
limitations: the deletion is document-specific and must not be generalized beyond the cited rule

sources.name: 9 April 2026 conduct-rule update
verified_claims: the conduct-crime finished rule was updated on 9 April 2026 to remove references to sections 4 and 4A Public Order
limitations: the change creates a version boundary for conduct-crime classification

sources.name: 7 April 2026 fraud-document update
verified_claims: NFIB fraud and notifiable-offence documents were updated on 7 April 2026
limitations: fraud-series interpretation requires the edition-matched documents

sources.name: 2 April 2026 frontline-rules update
verified_claims: frontline Crime Recording Rules were updated on 2 April 2026
limitations: earlier extracts must not be silently treated as the current edition

sources.name: ONS crime user-guide revision
verified_claims: the ONS user guide was last revised on 5 June 2026
limitations: revision date is not the reference period of every dataset described

sources.name: Crime-dataset compilation guide
verified_claims: the guide documents datasets used to compile crime statistics for England and Wales
limitations: dataset roles differ by offence and population coverage

sources.name: Crime classifications section
verified_claims: the guide includes a dedicated classifications section
limitations: classifications must be versioned with the relevant release

sources.name: Statistical conventions and methods
verified_claims: the guide includes statistical conventions and methods
limitations: headline numbers should not be interpreted without those conventions

sources.name: Recorded-crime list appendix
verified_claims: Appendix 1 contains the recorded crime list

sources.name: CSEW offences appendix
limitations: survey offences are not identical to police-recorded categories

sources.name: Report Fraud alignment appendix
verified_claims: Appendix 3 aligns Report Fraud offences to CSEW categories
limitations: alignment is a mapping and not record-level identity

sources.name: Open-table financial-year worksheets
verified_claims: main open-data tables contain one financial year per worksheet and use ODS format
limitations: worksheet name and financial quarter are both needed for period interpretation

sources.name: Open-table reference tables
verified_claims: the release includes two additional reference tables alongside the main data tables
limitations: fact rows must be joined using edition-matched reference data
